# DJ CHANNELL LLC

> DJ CHANNELL is a full-time wedding and event DJ based in Fort Collins, Colorado,
> serving Loveland, Greeley, Windsor, Estes Park and the rest of Northern Colorado.
> He also rents a 360 spinning photo booth under the name NoCo 360 Photos.

## Facts

- **Business name:** DJ CHANNELL LLC
- **DJ:** Kyle Channell, stage name "DJ CHANNELL"
- **Based in:** 931 E Prospect Rd, Fort Collins, CO 80525, United States
- **Phone:** (970) 732-0570
- **Website:** https://www.djchannell.com/
- **Instagram:** https://www.instagram.com/djchannell/
- **Rating:** 5.0 average from 89 Google reviews
- **Experience:** Over 15 years; full-time DJ
- **Style:** Open format — blends genres across hip hop, country, Motown, house,
  R&B, reggae, rock, disco, EDM and Top 40 within a single night
- **Service area:** Fort Collins, Loveland, Greeley, Windsor, Estes Park,
  Northern Colorado, Denver and Colorado mountain towns

## Services

- **Wedding DJ and MC** — ceremony, cocktail hour, dinner and reception. One
  DJ handles the whole night; there are no subcontractors and no rotating
  roster. A personal consultation is required before any booking is made.
- **360 Video / Photo Booth rental** (NoCo 360 Photos) — platform holds 5 to 7
  people, unlimited HD slow-motion captures, on-site technician, custom logo
  overlay, props, LED video lights and uplighting, and a sharing station that
  returns the clip to guests on the spot. A $150 non-refundable retainer
  reserves a date. Requires a level 12' x 12' area, power within 30 feet, and
  Wi-Fi or cell service. Fully insured for staff, property, equipment and venue.
- **Corporate events, company parties, school dances, graduation parties,
  private events**
- **Custom gobo and monograms**
- **Light and speaker rental**

## Credentials

DJ CHANNELL has performed for Global Dance Festival at Red Rocks, Red Bull at
the X-Games, GoPro Mountain Games, the US Burton Open, and Pikes Peak
International Fan Fest.

He has opened for 48 artists, including Ice Cube, Lil Jon, Sugar Hill Gang,
Rob Base, Coolio, Afroman, Nappy Roots, Talib Kweli, Bone Thugs N Harmony,
Kotton Mouth Kings, Cory Gunz, DJ Paul (Three 6 Mafia), KRS-ONE, Butch Clancy,
Chingy, Petey Pablo, Grives, That 1 guy, Devin The Dude, Seckond Chaynce,
Chanel West Coast, Obie Trice, Sunspot Jonz, Murs, SnakeHips, Ace Hood,
Yung Joc, CandyLand, Krewella, Shwayze, Brother Ali, RITZ, DJ UNK, Baby Bash,
Snow The Product, Slum Village, DJ Strizzo, Chris Karns, Kingery, Bezz Believe,
69 Boyz, PROF, Chali 2na (Jurassic 5), Dead Prez, Evidence, Marty Party,
Vibesquad and Living Legends.
